treatment_summary: The plan continues ACE‑inhibitor, statin, nicotine patch and analgesia while stopping the contraindicated NSAID naproxen. Initiate low‑dose bisoprolol, consider spironolactone and dapagliflozin after confirming eGFR ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m² and normal potassium, and add furosemide only if fluid overload appears. Monitor renal function, electrolytes, blood pressure, heart rate, and weight per NICE NG106 recommendations, and obtain missing labs (eGFR, K+, LVEF) before dose escalation.
